name: located-in
definition: Specifies the geographical country or territory where an organization or entity is located or based.

name: part-of
definition: Indicates that an entity is a structural component, agency, or division of another entity.

name: uses
definition: Indicates that an organization or actor employs a specific tool, platform, standard, or contact mechanism.

name: exploits
definition: Indicates that an entity takes advantage of a specific security vulnerability.

name: hosts
definition: Indicates that network infrastructure or a domain stores and serves a file or service.

name: delivers
definition: Indicates that a file, program, or channel drops, downloads, or installs a payload.
